summary: Issue #287 paired ideas migration with per-user RLS is correct and complete; no blocking issues found.

findings.description: Columns use mixed quoted camelCase (e.g. "compositeScore", "createdAt") instead of standard Postgres snake_case. The migration includes a comment explaining this avoids TS adapter logic for the existing Idea type, so this is an intentional trade-off.
tags is stored as jsonb rather than text[]. Either works for a string[] payload; jsonb is more flexible but text[] would be more idiomatic for plain tag lists.

Status 'archived' has no dedicated archivedAt timestamp, only completedAt. A later commit in the same session preserves completedAt across archive transitions — adequate, but a future enhancement could add archivedAt explicitly.
